system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Advanced (2): Reaper's Passing, The Leper's Gait

Base rating-tracker for the Mortis Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
